info.desc: Starboy is the third studio album by Canadian singer-songwriter The Weeknd, released on November 25, 2016, through XO and Republic Records. It features guest appearances from Daft Punk, Lana Del Rey, Kendrick Lamar and Future. Starboy was supported by seven singles, including the US Billboard Hot 100 number-one lead single of the same name and the top-five single "I Feel It Coming". It received generally favorable reviews from critics and debuted at number one on the US Billboard 200 with 348,000 album-equivalent units (209,000 of which were pure sales), becoming the Weeknd's second consecutive number-one album. podcast.body: In December 2016, all 18 tracks from this follow-up album by The Weeknd placed on the Hot 100, including the title track which hit number one, and deep cuts like "Die for You" (which reached #43). This unprecedented charting stunt for a single album signified a higher gear in his imperial phase during the digital music era. "One year later, The Weekend dropped a follow-up album called Starboy. In December of 2016, all 18 tracks from the album placed on the Hot 100."
